# Spencer OoT 12-hole alto C: measured numbers (generated by measure_spencer.py)

Scale: 165 mm on the longest chord of the body in each photo. s = station along the body axis, 0 at the bulb end, 1 at the tail tip. No photo is orthographic: stations are good to about ±0.02 on photo 03 and ±0.04 on the oblique ones; distances across the body depend on the roll of the body in the photo.

## 6. Thumb face (photo 04, strongly oblique: rough)

Apparent station t = position along the body axis in the picture. Corrected station s = t after a one-dimensional projective correction that puts the neck root (t = 0.220) at the station of photo 03 (0.363); correction factor k = 2.02. The true station lies between the two columns.

| Feature | Apparent t | Corrected s | Apparent size px (long × short) |
|---|---|---|---|
| R_thumb | 0.493 | 0.663 | 57 × 50 |
| L_thumb | 0.052 | 0.100 | 43 × 35 |
| window | 0.251 | 0.404 | 37 × 20 |
